title: Skip a frozen plan.md and generated index files in the doc-deferral scan
action: Per D9 (issue 115). `pub(crate) fn doc_deferral_scan_files(` in verbs/drivers/close.rs scans every touched docs/ file plus every markdown file under docs/history/<feature>/, so the door flags lines in the feature's frozen plan.md (the plan-freeze guard refuses edits once shape is approved) and in generated files such as docs/knowledge/patterns/index.md (rendered by `bee knowledge index`; its first bytes are KNOWLEDGE_INDEX_HEADER in verbs/knowledge/index.rs, which starts with `<!--\nGENERATED FILE — do not hand-edit.`). Drop from the returned list: (a) `docs/history/<feature>/plan.md` when the feature's shape gate is approved — reuse `crate::hooks::write_guard::plan_freeze_shape_approved` (already re-exported by `pub(crate) use self::checks::*;`) with the control root and the root's state; (b) any file whose content holds the generated-file header at the start or right after a leading frontmatter block (docs/knowledge/index.md puts okf frontmatter before it — see the format! in knowledge/index.rs) (compare against the KNOWLEDGE_INDEX_HEADER constant's first line, never a second copy of the text). `mod index;` in verbs/knowledge/mod.rs is private, so add one `pub(crate) use` re-export of KNOWLEDGE_INDEX_HEADER there;  Red first: in verbs/drivers/tests.rs next to the doc_deferral_door tests (rg -n "fn doc_deferral_door" verbs/drivers/tests.rs) add one test with a deferral line in a frozen plan.md and one with a deferral line in a generated index file; both must not block. Keep the existing doc_deferral tests green. No code comments. If cargo fails to compile in a file outside your files list, a sibling cell is mid-edit: wait 60 seconds and re-run; never edit that file.

truths: a deferral line in a frozen plan.md does not block the close door
a deferral line in a generated knowledge index file does not block the close door
a deferral line in an editable doc still blocks
prohibitions: No change to the baseline format
